A provider is a service your apps use: a model provider, a search API, people's Google accounts. Each page below says where to get the key, the steps, and the `everyapp` command that sets it.

**Supported** means three things:

- **Your Gateway holds the key.** You set it once, from your EveryApp folder, and every app that needs it uses it.
- **Apps declare what they need** in `everyapp.config.ts`, and `pnpm everyapp configure <app>` asks for exactly that.
- **Keys never reach app code.** The Gateway adds the key to each call, and only to that provider's own addresses.

Not listed? You can [add any provider yourself](/docs/providers/custom), or ask us for a page.

## AI models

- **[OpenAI](/docs/providers/openai)**: OpenAI's models: responses, chat, embeddings, audio, images. _model key_
- **[OpenRouter](/docs/providers/openrouter)**: One key for many models, through OpenAI's API shape. _model key_
- **[Workers AI](/docs/providers/workers-ai)**: Cloudflare's models, in the Gateway's own account. _model key_
- **[Cloudflare AI Gateway](/docs/providers/ai-gateway)**: Cloudflare's proxy in front of the other AI providers: logs, caching, rate limits and spend, with each provider's own key. _switch_
- **[Anthropic](/docs/providers/anthropic)**: Claude models through the Messages API. _model key_
- **[Google Gemini](/docs/providers/gemini)**: Google's Gemini models through their OpenAI-compatible endpoint: chat, embeddings, images. _model key_
- **[Mistral AI](/docs/providers/mistral)**: Mistral's models: chat, code completion, embeddings, moderation, OCR, speech. _model key_
- **[Groq](/docs/providers/groq)**: Open models on Groq through OpenAI's API shape: chat, responses, transcription, speech. _model key_
- **[Cohere](/docs/providers/cohere)**: Cohere's models: chat, embeddings, reranking, classification, transcription, document parsing. _model key_

## Speech, images and embeddings

- **[Voyage AI](/docs/providers/voyage)**: Embeddings and rerankers for search and retrieval: text, code, multimodal, contextualized chunks. _API key_
- **[Replicate](/docs/providers/replicate)**: Runs open-source and official models by API: images, video, audio and language. _API key_
- **[Hugging Face Inference](/docs/providers/huggingface)**: Open models from Hugging Face's inference providers through one router: chat, embeddings, images, speech. _API key_
- **[Deepgram](/docs/providers/deepgram)**: Speech to text, text to speech and text analysis. _API key_
- **[ElevenLabs](/docs/providers/elevenlabs)**: Text to speech, speech to text, sound effects, music and voice changing. _API key_
- **[AssemblyAI](/docs/providers/assemblyai)**: Transcribes recorded audio and video, with speaker labels, redaction and subtitles. _API key_

## Search, scraping and data

- **[DataForSEO](/docs/providers/dataforseo)**: SEO data: keyword metrics, live search results, domain rankings, backlinks. _API key_
- **[Context.dev](/docs/providers/context)**: Scrapes and renders web pages, JavaScript included. _API key_
- **[Mapbox](/docs/providers/mapbox)**: Maps and location: geocoding, directions, styles, tilesets and datasets. _API key_
- **[OpenWeather](/docs/providers/openweather)**: Weather data: current conditions, forecasts, One Call, history and weather map tiles. _API key_
- **[Perplexity](/docs/providers/perplexity)**: Web-grounded answers from the Agent API, raw web search results, and embeddings. _API key_
- **[Jina AI](/docs/providers/jina)**: Reads web pages as Markdown, searches the web, and embeds and reranks text and images. _API key_
- **[Firecrawl](/docs/providers/firecrawl)**: Scrapes, crawls, maps and searches the web, returning clean markdown or structured data. _API key_
- **[Exa](/docs/providers/exa)**: Web search built for AI: search results, page contents, similar links and cited answers. _API key_
- **[Tavily](/docs/providers/tavily)**: Web search, page extraction, crawling and site maps for AI agents, plus research reports. _API key_
- **[Serper](/docs/providers/serper)**: Google search results as JSON: web, news, images, places, shopping, scholar and patents. _API key_
- **[Brave Search](/docs/providers/brave-search)**: Brave's independent web index: web, news, images, videos, places, LLM context and answers. _API key_
- **[Apify](/docs/providers/apify)**: Runs Apify Actors (ready-made scrapers and automations) and reads their datasets and stores. _API key_
- **[NewsAPI](/docs/providers/newsapi)**: Searches news articles and live headlines from over 150,000 sources. _API key_

## Email and messaging

- **[Email sending](/docs/providers/email)**: Mail from the Gateway and every app, through Cloudflare Email Sending or Resend. _Gateway service_
- **[Slack](/docs/providers/slack)**: People connect their own Slack accounts. _connect accounts_
- **[Postmark](/docs/providers/postmark)**: Transactional email: single, batch and templated messages from one Postmark server. _API key_
- **[SendGrid](/docs/providers/sendgrid)**: Twilio SendGrid email: send transactional and marketing mail through the v3 Mail Send API. _API key_
- **[Twilio](/docs/providers/twilio)**: SMS, MMS and voice: send text messages and place calls from your Twilio numbers. _API key_
- **[Intercom](/docs/providers/intercom)**: Customer messaging: contacts, companies, conversations, tickets and help center articles. _API key_
- **[Crisp](/docs/providers/crisp)**: Customer chat: conversations, messages, people and visitors of one Crisp workspace. _API key_

## Payments and commerce

- **[Stripe](/docs/providers/stripe)**: Payments: customers, subscriptions, invoices, charges and payouts. _API key_
- **[Lemon Squeezy](/docs/providers/lemonsqueezy)**: Merchant of record for software: stores, products, orders, subscriptions, license keys. _API key_
- **[Paddle](/docs/providers/paddle)**: Paddle Billing: products, prices, customers, subscriptions and transactions. _API key_
- **[Shopify](/docs/providers/shopify)**: One store's Admin API (GraphQL): products, orders, customers and inventory. _API key_
- **[Plaid](/docs/providers/plaid)**: Bank data: accounts, balances, transactions and identity, for the Items an app links. _API key_

## CRM, docs and work tools

- **[Google](/docs/providers/google)**: People connect their own accounts: Gmail, Calendar, Search Console and Analytics. _connect accounts, sign in_
- **[Microsoft](/docs/providers/microsoft)**: People connect their own accounts: Outlook mail and calendar. _connect accounts, sign in_
- **[Attio](/docs/providers/attio)**: CRM: people, companies, deals, lists, notes and tasks in one Attio workspace. _API key_
- **[HubSpot](/docs/providers/hubspot)**: CRM and marketing: contacts, companies, deals, tickets and more in one HubSpot account. _API key, connect accounts_
- **[Pipedrive](/docs/providers/pipedrive)**: Sales CRM: deals, persons, organizations, activities and pipelines. _API key_
- **[Airtable](/docs/providers/airtable)**: Bases, tables and records in the Airtable workspaces a token can reach. _API key_
- **[Notion](/docs/providers/notion)**: Pages, databases and blocks that a Notion connection has been given. _API key, connect accounts_
- **[Linear](/docs/providers/linear)**: Issue tracking over GraphQL: issues, projects, cycles, comments and teams. _API key, connect accounts_
- **[Atlassian (Jira and Confluence)](/docs/providers/atlassian)**: Jira issues and Confluence pages on the sites the person grants. _connect accounts_
- **[Zoom](/docs/providers/zoom)**: The person's meetings and recordings. _connect accounts_
- **[Dropbox](/docs/providers/dropbox)**: Files and folders in the person's Dropbox. _connect accounts_

## Developer tools and infrastructure

- **[GitHub](/docs/providers/github)**: Code hosting: repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions and releases through the REST API. _API key, connect accounts, sign in_
- **[GitLab](/docs/providers/gitlab)**: Code hosting on GitLab.com: projects, issues, merge requests, pipelines and releases. _API key, connect accounts_
- **[Vercel](/docs/providers/vercel)**: Frontend hosting: projects, deployments, domains and logs through the Vercel REST API. _API key_
- **[Cloudflare](/docs/providers/cloudflare)**: Cloudflare's API: zones, DNS, Workers, R2, D1, KV and the rest of an account. _API key, sign in_
- **[PostHog](/docs/providers/posthog)**: Product analytics: insights, feature flags, persons, cohorts, experiments and HogQL queries. _API key_
- **[Mixpanel](/docs/providers/mixpanel)**: Product analytics: saved reports, profiles, raw event export and event import. _API key_
- **[Segment](/docs/providers/segment)**: Sends identify, track, page, group and alias events to a Segment source. _API key_
- **[Supabase](/docs/providers/supabase)**: A Supabase project's Postgres REST API and Storage, with its secret key. _API key_
- **[Turso](/docs/providers/turso)**: Turso's Platform API: databases, groups, locations and usage for one organization. _API key_
- **[Neon](/docs/providers/neon)**: Neon's management API: Postgres projects, branches, databases, roles and endpoints. _API key_
- **[Pinecone](/docs/providers/pinecone)**: Vector database: indexes, namespaces, vectors and documents, plus hosted embedding and rerank. _API key_

## Sign-in only

- **[Apple](/docs/providers/apple)**: "Continue with Apple" on your Gateway's sign-in page. _sign in_
- **[Single sign-on (OIDC)](/docs/providers/oidc)**: "Continue with SSO" on your Gateway's sign-in page. _sign in_

## Not listed

- [Add a custom provider](/docs/providers/custom): any API with a key, or any OAuth provider, in one JSON file.
- [Remote MCP servers](/docs/agent/mcp#mcp-apps): add an MCP server by its URL and your agents get its tools.
